## Model Context Protocol (MCP) & AI Agent Discovery
TL;DR: Native Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for autonomous AI agents (Hermes, Claude Desktop, Cursor, AgentKit) to query, verify, and route into Base yield primitives with strict APY sanity bounds (<= 1000%) and zero rate hallucinations.
- Visual Documentation & Schema Explorer: https://www.defi.garden/mcp
- Machine-Native MCP Endpoint: https://www.defi.garden/api/mcp
- Streamable Transports: HTTP POST (JSON-RPC 2.0), Server-Sent Events (SSE)
- Core Tools: `get_base_yields`, `find_lending_rate`, `get_looping_params`, `get_trust_rails`
